title: EpicBugScreenVerdict
description: Output of one single-turn epic-close bug-screen call (ticket 4b54). The screen is a narrow forced-choice relevance triage of one open/in_progress out-of-hierarchy bug against the epic under close: A = the bug describes a defect in something this epic changed/built or behavior its acceptance criteria claim; B = same subsystem but pre-existing or adjacent; C = unrelated. Only A-verdicts are forwarded to the completion verifier. Consumers normalize any out-of-vocabulary verdict to C (the non-surfacing safe default) — a garbled screen output degrades open and never fabricates a candidate.

verdict.description: The forced choice. A = defect in the epic's own deliverable; B = same subsystem, pre-existing or adjacent; C = unrelated.

citation.description: One line naming the epic deliverable / bug content that justifies the verdict.
